propositions: Compaction was removed from the close path to prevent a 13m53s store lock hold that starved concurrent agents, but left stores with no standing compaction trigger and event logs growing unbounded
Two independent triggers are needed: a scheduled sweep for CI environments (6-hourly via GitHub Actions) and an operation-linked detached worker for stores without CI or local cron

The sweep's ticket selection must converge by applying two arms: backfill (no SNAPSHOT and at least one foldable event) and recurrence (foldable count exceeding threshold), never re-selecting the same ticket

The operation-linked trigger must not reintroduce the original lock-hold P0, using a stamped advisory lock and detached worker spawning that holds the lock only during atomic mutations (SNAPSHOT write, renames, commit)
The sweep walks git history per ticket under the store write lock, recreating bug 7084 at scale; history must be walked once per sweep outside the lock, then amortized across all tickets
